AppSettings.//ConfigKeysWithheldFromScripts: Config values never published into deployment script scope. Omit to use the built-in set - the three operator-only credentials a production share scan showed no script consumes. Extend as script consumers of the remaining secure keys are migrated.
AppSettings.//EnforceScriptPathConfinement: False (default): a component script path that would resolve outside ScriptRoot is reported and still executed. True: it is refused. Enable once the report shows the estate is clean.
AppSettings.//ScriptContentVerification: Report (default): a script whose content differs from its recorded baseline is logged and still executed. Enforce: it is refused. Off: neither captured nor verified. Absent or unrecognised means Report.
AppSettings.//DeploymentCredentialsFromVault: False (default): deployment credentials are the DORC_*DeployUsername/Password configuration values. True: they are read from the secrets vault using the four item ids below, and a missing item refuses the deployment rather than falling back.
AppSettings.//OnePassword: The vault the four item ids below are read from when DeploymentCredentialsFromVault is True. Unused otherwise.
AppSettings.//AllowedArtefactHosts: Hosts that may receive default Windows credentials for artefact access. Empty denies credential use.
AppSettings.//AllowedTerraformSourceHosts: Hosts that may provide Terraform code and receive Git credentials. Empty denies Git source use.
